facts.fact: Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda and South Sudan opened a joint bank account at Standard Chartered Bank Uganda to fund a feasibility study for a jointly government-owned regional communications satellite, with a 30 September 2026 deadline for contributions; the report gives no date for the meeting, so 2026-08-24 is the report's date.
facts.system: Northern Corridor regional communications and broadcasting satellite

systems.owner: Governments of Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda and South Sudan (proposed joint ownership)
